name: Zichri
title: Warrior from Ephraim
summary: Zichri was a mighty warrior from the tribe of Ephraim who served under Pekah, king of Israel. During the war between the Northern Kingdom (Israel) and the Southern Kingdom (Judah), Zichri killed three prominent men from Judah: Maaseiah the king's son, Azrikam the palace administrator, and Elkanah, who was second only to the king in authority.

keyEvents.title: The War between Israel and Judah
keyEvents.description: During King Pekah's war against King Ahaz of Judah, Zichri fought as a mighty warrior from Ephraim on Israel's side.

keyEvents.title: The Killing of Prince Maaseiah
keyEvents.description: Zichri killed Maaseiah, the son of King Ahaz of Judah, in battle.

keyEvents.title: The Killing of Palace Administrator Azrikam
keyEvents.description: Zichri also killed Azrikam, who was the administrator over the king's palace in Judah.

keyEvents.title: The Killing of Elkanah
keyEvents.description: Zichri killed Elkanah, who was the second most powerful man after the king in Judah, demonstrating his strength in battle.

keyEvents.title: Israel's Victory over Judah
keyEvents.description: Zichri's deeds were part of a greater military victory in which Israel defeated Judah, inflicting a massive loss of 120,000 men in one day, because Judah had forsaken the Lord, the God of their ancestors.
